```yaml
name: Update Meeting Minutes

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * *' # Runs daily at midnight UTC
  workflow_dispatch:   # Allows manual trigger

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  update-minutes:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Install jq
        run: sudo apt-get update && sudo apt-get install -y jq

      - name: Fetch latest community post
        env:
          DISCOURSE_URL: https://discuss.layer5.io
        run: |
          # Get the latest topic ID and title from the community category
          TOPIC_JSON=$(curl -s "${DISCOURSE_URL}/c/community/latest.json")
          TOPIC_ID=$(echo "$TOPIC_JSON" | jq -r '.topic_list.topics[0].id')
          TOPIC_TITLE=$(echo "$TOPIC_JSON" | jq -r '.topic_list.topics[0].title')

          # Get the raw content of the first post in the topic
          POST_JSON=$(curl -s "${DISCOURSE_URL}/t/${TOPIC_ID}.json")
          POST_RAW=$(echo "$POST_JSON" | jq -r '.post_stream.posts[0].raw')

          # Prepare the markdown file
          DATE=$(date -u +%Y-%m-%d)
          FILE_PATH=".github/meetings/archive/${DATE}.md"
          mkdir -p "$(dirname "$FILE_PATH")"

          cat > "$FILE_PATH" <<EOF
          # ${TOPIC_TITLE}

          ${POST_RAW}
          EOF

          # Check if the file has changed
          if git diff --quiet "$FILE_PATH"; then
            echo "No changes detected in ${FILE_PATH}. Skipping commit."
            exit 0
          fi

          # Commit and push changes
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add "$FILE_PATH"
          git commit -m "Update meeting minutes: ${DATE}"
          git push origin HEAD:main
```
